April 20, 2022

What we did today/what is that like?

Highlands Circuit Race, which is 20 laps of a 5-mile circuit with a gigantic hill. 

How did I do? 

HAHAHAHAHAHAHA – 123/162.

Quote of the day

“California would be beautiful if there weren’t people in it.”

What I hated about today

Cornering and the sound of 162 dudes freewheeling at 45 mph into a narrowing road. 
 

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Mediocre power reveal
 

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Lap 1: OMFG JESUS WE’RE ALL GOING TO CRASH AND DIE OMFG I’M GOING TO GET POPPED ON THE FIRST LAP WE’RE GOING SO HARD WE HAVE TO DO THIS 20 TIMES?????
